name: image-trail
title: Image Trail
description: Moving the cursor across an area drops a trail of images that appear, linger briefly and shrink away, cycling through a set.

meta.reducedMotion: The images are shown as a static row instead.
meta.useWhen: Photographers, archives, studios with a deep body of work; one area per page.
meta.avoidWhen: Fewer than 5 images; e-commerce product pages; over text that must be read.
